questions_answers.question: What is Government Polytechnic Proddatur?
questions_answers.answer: Government Polytechnic Proddatur is a government-run technical education institution that provides diploma-level engineering education.

questions_answers.question: Tell me about Government Polytechnic Proddatur.
questions_answers.answer: Government Polytechnic Proddatur is a technical education institution established to provide diploma-level engineering education and develop skilled technical professionals.

questions_answers.question: When was Government Polytechnic Proddatur established?
questions_answers.answer: Government Polytechnic Proddatur was established in 1959.

questions_answers.question: When did Government Polytechnic Proddatur start?
questions_answers.answer: Government Polytechnic Proddatur started in 1959 as a government-run technical education institute.

questions_answers.question: What was the purpose of establishing the college?
questions_answers.answer: The institution was established to provide diploma-level engineering education in the region.

questions_answers.question: Under which department was the polytechnic established?
questions_answers.answer: Government Polytechnic Proddatur was established under the Department of Technical Education, Government of Andhra Pradesh.

questions_answers.question: Which department controls Government Polytechnic Proddatur?
questions_answers.answer: The institution operates under the Department of Technical Education, Government of Andhra Pradesh.

questions_answers.question: Is Government Polytechnic Proddatur affiliated to SBTET?
questions_answers.answer: Yes. Government Polytechnic Proddatur is affiliated to the State Board of Technical Education and Training (SBTET), Andhra Pradesh.

questions_answers.question: What is SBTET?
questions_answers.answer: SBTET stands for State Board of Technical Education and Training.

questions_answers.question: Is Government Polytechnic Proddatur approved by AICTE?
questions_answers.answer: Yes. Government Polytechnic Proddatur is approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE).

questions_answers.question: What is AICTE?
questions_answers.answer: AICTE stands for All India Council for Technical Education.

questions_answers.question: Which engineering branches were offered when the college started?
questions_answers.answer: When the institution started in 1959, it offered three core diploma engineering branches: Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering and Electrical Engineering.

questions_answers.question: Which courses were available in 1959?
questions_answers.answer: In 1959, the institution offered diploma programs in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering and Electrical Engineering.

questions_answers.question: What was the initial intake of the branches?
questions_answers.answer: Each of the three initial branches had an intake of about 40 students.

questions_answers.question: When was Electronics and Communication Engineering introduced?
questions_answers.answer: Electronics and Communication Engineering was introduced in 1985.

questions_answers.question: When did the ECE branch start?
questions_answers.answer: The Electronics and Communication Engineering branch was introduced in 1985 with an intake capacity of around 50 students.

questions_answers.question: What was the intake of ECE when it was introduced?
questions_answers.answer: The Electronics and Communication Engineering branch was introduced with an intake capacity of around 50 students.

questions_answers.question: When was Computer Engineering introduced?
questions_answers.answer: The Diploma in Computer Engineering was introduced in 2006.

questions_answers.question: Why was Computer Engineering introduced?
questions_answers.answer: Computer Engineering was added in 2006 to meet the growing demand for computer science and information technology skills among students.

questions_answers.question: Which branch was introduced in 2006?
questions_answers.answer: Diploma in Computer Engineering was introduced in 2006.

questions_answers.question: What happened to the college during 2008-2009?
questions_answers.answer: During 2008-2009, Government Polytechnic Proddatur was among ten polytechnic institutes selected to introduce additional second sections in some programs.

questions_answers.question: Which branches received additional second sections during 2008-2009?
questions_answers.answer: Additional second sections were introduced in programs such as Mechanical Engineering, ECE, EEE and Sandwich branches.

questions_answers.question: How has Government Polytechnic Proddatur developed over the years?
questions_answers.answer: Over the decades, the institution has expanded its intake capacity, upgraded its facilities and introduced multiple diploma programs in core and modern engineering disciplines.

questions_answers.question: How are students admitted to the diploma programs?
questions_answers.answer: Admission to the diploma programs is typically through the AP POLYCET entrance examination, the common polytechnic entrance test in Andhra Pradesh.

questions_answers.question: What is AP POLYCET?
questions_answers.answer: AP POLYCET is the common polytechnic entrance examination in Andhra Pradesh used for admission to diploma-level polytechnic programs.

questions_answers.question: What qualifications do students receive from the college?
